value.rationale: Triangular probability kernels are natural compactly supported approximation kernels. The full-cell Fourier noncancellation constant and irrationality-exponent law classify the severity of near-zeros even under Wiener cyclicity, distinguishing badly approximable, typical, and Liouville knot positions. This supplies precisely motivated global conditioning information absent from the classical characteristic function and from a pure qualitative zero test.
